iOS 27.2 beta 2 was released today, and so far the user interface changes appear to be relatively minor. However, the code in the iOS 27.2 beta version indicates that features such as Apple Music and CarPlay Ultra are brewing new changes.

Leakers have discovered hidden features of iOS 27.2 from the beta code

Every time Apple releases a new beta software, we usually use two methods to find out what has changed: one is the user features already enabled within the software, and the other is changes to the underlying code, which often foreshadow future updates.

iOS 27.2 already had quite a few new features available for testing on day one, including a revamped Health app, user profiles added to Apple TV, expanded Siri AI features, and more.

However, users familiar with the underlying code have found more changes in the works.

For example, X user pdfu discovered that Apple Music will soon include a real-time countdown feature for new album releases.

pdfu also made another discovery in the iOS 27.2 beta code, related to the Shortcuts app.

The new Shortcuts feature "Describe a Shortcut" appears to soon support adding actions from third-party apps.

Another noteworthy discovery in the iOS 27.2 code involves CarPlay Ultra.

Aaron Perris discovered that the code mentions a "Drive Mode Theme," which can change the dashboard style and color, and even sync with the ambient lighting in the car.

CarPlay Ultra is currently only available for Aston Martin models. However, the addition of the new theme feature may suggest that Apple is preparing to extend support to other car manufacturers.

We previously reported that iOS 27.2 will include a feature to more thoroughly wipe iPhone data. Today's beta 2 includes more detailed descriptive text — this feature is now called "Extended Erase," as discovered by Aaron Perris.

Finally, Perris found evidence suggesting that Apple may be preparing a demo mode for its upcoming smart home device "HomePad".

Among the new and upcoming features in iOS 27.2, which one are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
